name: BONBID-HIE Lesion Segmentation Challenge
description: Measures lesion segmentation performance on Boston neonatal brain injury (HIE) imaging data.
evaluation_method: Dice coefficient (primary), with IoU and Hausdorff distance as common secondary metrics
reputation: Specialized medical imaging challenge for neonatal HIE lesion segmentation; relevant within neuroimaging and neonatal radiology research but niche outside that community.
notes: Small and sensitive clinical dataset with strict privacy/usage restrictions. High class imbalance (small lesion volumes) and variability across scanners/subjects; clinical validation required before deployment.
